detail.longDescription:
I want the ability to close our #github repo to external PRs, but then also to be able to grant users a "ticket" to open a PR. They can use that ticket to open one PR. 

That alone would cut down on so much unsolicited PR slop. It would force users to actually engage in threads with us (maintainers), and come to a shared understanding _before_ filing the PR at us. 

who says no?
